entities.summary: Giovanni Ciampoli or Giovanni Battista Ciampoli was a priest, poet and humanist. He was closely associated with Galileo Galilei and his disputes with the Catholic Church. Giovanni Ciampoli was a theologians & scholars from Florence (1589, Florence–1643-09-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
